prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental event piece about free-flowing traffic hit by a phantom jam that travels backward. Around 120 BPM, E minor. A steady analog pulse is the flow; stuttering percussion is braking; a reverse cymbal is the backward-propagating wave; low brass is pressure, not a fanfare melody. Tense, physical. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No car-horn samples, no police sirens, no trailer drum corps.

[00:00–00:25] Smooth analog pulse, even, confident.
[00:25–00:50] One hitch; percussion stutters; pulse bunches.
[00:50–01:25] Jam wave travels: density moves backward through the stereo field.
[01:25–02:00] Release downstream; pulse recovers unevenly.
[02:00–02:30] Flow returns, a little more cautious.
